svg.title: Project Aegis Architecture
svg.desc: Three-column architecture: Atomic Red Team simulates activity on Windows, Winlogbeat sends endpoint events to Elasticsearch, Elastic Security produces native SIEM alerts, and Aegis pulls alerts via API for parallel analyst and critic reviews, server join, report writing and SQLite audit storage. The LLM gateway is external.

g.text: Atomic metadata stays outside AI evidence
REST APIs · SIEM integration · MCP adapter
